settings.text: This mask is incredible. I fell in love with it after one use and use it once a week now. I have very course, wavy, dry hair that I straighten often. I was noticing a ton of damage at my ends and my hair was so brittle. I bought this mask and after one use my hair was softer, shinier, smoother, less frizzy, and my split ends were starting to repair. After consistent use my hair looks the best it ever has . I am HOOKED!
